status: Specified before the lock-matched historical mutation measurements; informed by earlier current-suite assertion-only exclusions.
secondaryPolicy: posthoc-test-failures-v1, reused from the separate current-suite sensitivity analysis
scope: All primary verified historical replays with retained mutation matrices, including partial matrices. Derive a separate matrix from the retained complete test-body failure records; reject runner, hook, import, unhandled, identity, runtime identity/command and cleanup problems. No additional test executions.
faultLabels: Keep the primary assertion-regression eligibility and detecting-test labels; do not add fault labels from exceptions or reclassify excluded historical changes as verified.
requirements: Recompute dynamic minimal nonempty kill-signature classes for the secondary full test pool and hold them fixed for per-test removal and subset evaluation.

comparisons.aggregation: Average seeds within faults, then resample related-fault groups. Complete secondary matrices only. Keep primary and secondary aggregates separate; never select each fault best result across profiles.
comparisons.cohortCounts: Show eligible fault and related-group counts for each aggregate. Any direct primary/secondary performance comparison uses their paired eligible intersection; added secondary-eligible faults are a separate aggregate.

retention: Bind every derived matrix to the exact primary matrix and event hashes; preserve primary bytes and every derivation exclusion.
interpretation: This checks sensitivity to a conventional test-failure policy. Extra usable kills or a larger eligible ranking cohort do not establish stronger assertions or a validated test-retention score.
bindingControls: Bind primary attempts, fault record, preregistration, recordDigests, matrix and every event SHA.
Reject orphan/interrupted records and incomplete declared prefixes against registered planning outputs/limit.
Exercise actual historical fixed-before baseline path and preregistration Node identity fallback.
Reject stale fault/event/runtime evidence and incomplete columns.
Assert unchanged primary bytes and unchanged primary assertion fault labels.
